oliver: heads-up — spun up a trace-driven A/B harness to probe continuous-batching token-budget autotuning. goal: find sweet spot for batch formation when KV-prefetch reduces cold-token cost. sharing quick notes + run command.
anya: nice! can you paste the exact sim invocation? would love to replicate locally :eyes:
mike: curious which traces you used — prod vs canary? also what metric are we optimizing (p99 latency, tokens/op, or cost-per-token)?
oliver: used 03-16-prod-traces + a smaller canary sample. primary metrics: p99 latency (ms), effective tokens/sec on GPU, and cost per generated token. run:
```
./tools/replay --traces s3://traces/2026-03-16.tgz \
  --policy adaptive_queuecraft \
  --token-budget 384 --kv-prefetch=on \
  --kernelset auto_select --out results/tracecamp/run-1769456789
```
devon: can you paste the adaptive_queuecraft config? I want to see the score function we used for merging queues.
ojiver: (typo) -> oliver: oops typo
oliver: paste of the runtime config we toggled:
```
{"batch_window_ms":8, "max_tokens_per_batch":4096, "token_budget_target":384, "merge_score":"latency_delta / tokens_saved", "prefetch_warmup":128}
```
jess: small ask: include a control run withkv-prefetch=off so we can A/B delta on cold-start p99. also capture kernel selection decisions (which kernels chosen at sequence lengths 32/128/512).
ci-bot: build #replay-harness started for run-1769456789 · status: queued
mike: initial sim pass looks interesting — with prefetch on we see ~12% token-cost drop but p99 increases ~6ms at tail. full logs at s3://r-internal/results/tracecamp/run-1769456789/log.txt
anya: can we try token_budget_target sweep: [128,256,384,640] and report throughput vs p99? maybe target interacts with kernel selection.
devon: agree. I suspect kernel selector picks faster but less-quantized kernels when batches get larger; that hurts cost. we should log kernel id per invocation.
oliver: added kernel-logging patch to harness. new runs scheduled: sweep + control. ci-bot: build #replay-harness started for sweep-1769456795 · status: running
jess: quick note — if merge_score uses tokens_saved in denominator we might bias toward merging tiny batches. consider regularizing with a floor: tokens_saved + 8.
mike: good call. also observed that prefetch_warmup=128 reduces cold misses but increases eviction churn for busy models. might need hysteresis on prefetch window.
oliver: planned next steps: (1) run sweep with kernel logging + kv-prefetch toggles, (2) export per-route p99/cost CSV, (3) pick candidate token_budget_target for canary rollout. adding short checklist in case anyone wants to jump in:
- add kernel_id to replay CSV
- run sweep (128,256,384,640) x prefetch on/off
- compare p99, tokens/sec, cost/token per route
- sanity-check model outputs on sample prompts

anya: i'll take the kernel logging change and sanity-check outputs tomorrow.
devon: i'll analyze the sweep results when they're ready. can you ping in #eng-runtime when done? :thumbsup:
ci-bot: build #replay-harness completed for run-1769456789 · status: success · artifacts: s3://r-internal/results/tracecamp/run-1769456789/
oliver: thanks all — will post a short summary with CSVs once the sweep finishes.
